strategy.name: Trend + Breakout Swing
strategy.hypothesis: Stocks in an uptrend that break their 20-day high on above-average volume, while outperforming NIFTY, tend to continue for a few weeks. Only trade when the index itself is in an uptrend.

score: +2 price > 50-day SMA > 200-day SMA (uptrend); -2 if the reverse
+1 21-day SMA crossed above 50-day within 4 bars; -1 if crossed below
+1 RSI(14) between 50 and 70; -1 if between 30 and 45
+2 close above previous 20-day high with volume > 1.5x 20-day average; -2 for a 20-day low
+1 3-month return beats NIFTY; -1 if it lags
rules.entry: score >= +5 AND index regime BULL (or SIDEWAYS with score >= +6); no news-risk words in last 3 days
rules.exit: score <= -5 (SELL), stop 2xATR below entry, target 3xATR above, trailing stop 4% once up 5%, time exit 20 bars, regime turns BEAR
rules.sizing: 1% of equity at risk between entry and stop; <= 25% of equity; <= 5% of 20-day volume; halve size when index 20-day vol > 25%
